task_description: 归一锂离子电池电芯流程：沿用已有 lithium_ion_battery 节点，将电芯制造登记为其稳定工艺，并补足工艺输出关系。

nodes_to_upsert.definition: 将正极、负极、隔膜和电解液等部件经电极制造、电芯装配、注液、化成和分容等工序制成可充放电锂离子电池电芯的制造过程。

evidence.source_title: DOE/EA-1709: Lithium-ion polymer battery cell manufacturing process
evidence.quote: The cell manufacturing process is highly automated and consists of three main operations, including Electrode Manufacturing; Cell Assembly; and Formation and Grading.

edges_to_upsert.description: 锂离子电池电芯制造工艺产出可充放电的锂离子电池电芯。

evidence.source_title: DOE/EA-1709: Lithium-ion polymer battery cell manufacturing process
evidence.quote: The cell manufacturing process is highly automated and consists of three main operations, including Electrode Manufacturing; Cell Assembly; and Formation and Grading.

rejected_or_pending.reason: 与现有 lithium_ion_battery 的别名“锂电芯”指代同一锂离子电池电芯实体，重复新建会割裂流程和公司暴露。
rejected_or_pending.notes: 流程资源统一使用 lithium_ion_battery。
